dos.text: Listen for MozInputSearch:search rather than input if you are running a query, handleInput debounces it by 500ms and passes the current text as detail.query.
Set iconSrc to an empty string to remove the magnifier, the icon check treats an undefined iconSrc as having an icon, so leaving it unset keeps the default one.

donts.text: Don't set readonly on a search input, its inputTemplate overrides the base and never passes readonly to the inner input, so the property reflects onto the host and changes nothing.
Don't rely on input or change to observe clear(), it only dispatches MozInputSearch:search, and only when the value was non-empty to begin with.
Don't remove the element within 500ms of the last keystroke and expect the final search, disconnectedCallback clears the pending debounce timer.
